=SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(litros_facturados), 0) as total_litros_factura,
  COALESCE(SUM(importe_total), 0) as total_importe_factura,
  COUNT(*) as total_facturas_count,
  COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'id', id,
    'folio', folio_factura,
    'proveedor', proveedor,
    'litros', litros_facturados,
    'importe', importe_total,
    'fecha', fecha_factura,
    'obra', obra_destino
  )) FILTER (WHERE id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::json) as facturas_detalle
FROM diesel.facturas
WHERE (TRIM(semana) = '{{ $json.body.semana }}' OR TRIM(semana) = 'Semana {{ $json.body.semana }}')
  AND (obra_destino = '{{ $json.body.obra_destino }}' OR '{{ $json.body.obra_destino }}' = '' OR '{{ $json.body.obra_destino }}' = 'TODAS');

=SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(litros), 0) as total_litros_cargas,
  COALESCE(SUM(importe_total), 0) as total_importe_cargas,
  COUNT(*) as total_cargas_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN foto_evidencia IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as cargas_con_foto,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN horometro_inicial IS NOT NULL AND horometro_inicial > 0 THEN 1 END) as cargas_con_horometro,
  COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'id', id,
    'folio', folio_conciliacion,
    'fecha', fecha,
    'equipo', equipo_economico,
    'litros', litros,
    'importe', importe_total,
    'operador', operador,
    'responsable', responsable,
    'horometro', horometro_inicial,
    'tiene_foto', (foto_evidencia IS NOT NULL)
  )) FILTER (WHERE id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::json) as cargas_detalle
FROM diesel.consumos
WHERE (TRIM(semana) = '{{ $('Webhook: Conciliacion Diesel').item.json.body.semana }}' OR TRIM(semana) = 'Semana {{ $('Webhook: Conciliacion Diesel').item.json.body.semana }}')
  AND (obra_destino = '{{ $('Webhook: Conciliacion Diesel').item.json.body.obra_destino }}' OR '{{ $('Webhook: Conciliacion Diesel').item.json.body.obra_destino }}' = '' OR '{{ $('Webhook: Conciliacion Diesel').item.json.body.obra_destino }}' = 'TODAS');
